caption: the week ahead, jan 11 to jan 17: mercury in aquarius, mercury meets pluto, venus squares a retrograde mars.

slides.headline: *venus* gets a little intense, in a good way
slides.body: astrologers read it as honest depth. a night for the real conversation, not the third rerun.

slides.headline: *mercury* enters aquarius: think in big ideas
slides.body: read it as detached, inventive talk. great for ideas, rough on feelings.

slides.headline: mercury meets *pluto*: the conversation goes deep
slides.body: astrologers read it as the truth surfacing. ask, then listen.

slides.headline: *venus* squares a retrograde mars
slides.body: want and timing disagree. read it as a weekend to flirt, not force. the slow answer is still an answer.

slides.headline: cool head, *warm heart*. you need both.
slides.body: save this for wednesday, when mercury changes sign.
